workflow.name: Parallel review, one report
workflow.description: Three read-only reviews run in parallel after a shared analysis; a report stage waits for all three.

prompts.label: analyze
prompts.text: Map the architecture of {{variables.target}}: modules, entry points, data flow.

prompts.label: security
prompts.text: Review {{variables.target}} for security problems. Use the analysis you were given.

prompts.label: performance
prompts.text: Review {{variables.target}} for performance problems. Use the analysis you were given.

prompts.label: quality
prompts.text: Review {{variables.target}} for readability and maintainability. Use the analysis you were given.

prompts.label: report
prompts.text: Merge the three reviews of {{variables.target}} into one report: deduplicate, rank by severity, one recommendation per finding.
